book.name: Juan
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Juan

content: To Pagdakop ki Jesus
Tapus makaampu si Jesus, migyopa sikandin to sapa to Kidron duma to mgo inanad din. Migpadajun sikandan duon to banwa no mey kakajuhan no tinanom.
Na, si Judas no ogyuib ki Jesus namaan to sikan no banwa, su si Jesus dow to mgo inanad din kanunoy man oghihimun duon.

Kaling pigdaya ni Judas to mgo sundayu duon. Migduma isab to mgo magbantajay duon to Bayoy to Diyus no pigsugu to yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan dow mgo Pariseo. Migdaya sikandan to mgo ispada dow taepos hasta mgo mitsa dow sayong no sinogaan.
Na, tahan on namaan si Jesus to tibo ogkahitabu kandin. Kaling pigtagbu din sikandan aw usipa, “Hintawa man to tuud now?”
Kagi dan, “Si Jesus no taga-Nazaret.” (Duma dan si Judas no migyuib ki Jesus.) Kagi ni Jesus, “Siak.”
Pagdinog dan to sikan kagi din, nakaus-us sikandan aw kangkatuad.
Mig-usip on isab si Jesus, “Hintawa man yagboy to tuud now?” Migtabak sikandan, “Si Jesus no taga-Nazaret.”
Kagi ni Jesus, “Pignangonan kud sikiyu no siakon. Na, ko siak man to tuud now, seini a. Di kona now igyakip seini mgo duma ku.”
Pig-ikagi din sikan agun no matuman to diya ing-ampu din no pig-iling, “Wada sobuuk no nagawang to seini mgo otow no imbogoy nu kanay.”
Dajun huyabut si Pedro to ispada din aw hambosa si Malco no suguonon to sikan kinayabawan no magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru, aw kasagping to kalintuu no talinga din.
Di kagi ni Jesus, “Isug-ub sikan ispada nu. Kinahangyan no mabajaan ku to mgo antusonon no igpaantus kanay to Amoy ku.”
To Pagpaatubanga ki Jesus ki Anas
Na, pigdakop si Jesus aw gapusa to sikan mgo sundayu binuligan to yabow dan hasta to mgo magbantajay to Bayoy to Diyus.
Una dan sikandin pigdaya diya ki Anas no ugangan ni Caifas no kinayabawan no magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru to sikan no tuig.
Na, si Caifas to diya migsambag to mgo inila no madojow ko songo otow da podom to mamatoy agun no kona mamatoy to tibo angod din no mgo Hibru.
To Paglidung ni Pedro ki Jesus

Na, migyupug ki Jesus si Pedro dow to duma din no songo inanad. Pagtidow dan diya to bayoy to kinayabawan no magdudumaya to tinuuhan, iyan da nakapadajun sikan duma ni Pedro diya to pawa, su kiyaya sikandin to sikan tag-bayoy.
Di si Pedro nabilin da diya to yuwas. Pagkahina-hina migyuwas sikan duma din aw ikagihi sikan bohi no migbantoy to yawanganan. Dajun din dumaha si Pedro duon to pawa.
Dajun usipa si Pedro to sikan bohi, “Kona no sobuuk ka man no inanad to sikan otow?” Miglidung si Pedro, kagi din, “Eh, kona.”
Na, meyduon mgo suguonon dow mgo magbantajay no migbuhi to kaeju dow panghinadang su mahagsiy to diya no kadukiloman. Migpagsakot si Pedro kandan aw panghinadang isab.
To Pag-imbistiga ni Anas ki Jesus
Na, si Jesus no diyad on to sed to bayoy pigpangusip to sikan kinayabawan no magdudumaya to tinuuhan bahin to mgo otow no inanad din hasta to pagpang-anad din.

Migtabak si Jesus, “To pagpang-anad ku to kaotawan wada lipod-lipod su duon a kanunoy pang-anad to mgo simbahan ta hasta duon to Bayoy to Diyus no oghihimunan to tibo mgo Hibru. Wada a hinobong no nang-anad.
Nokoy no siak man to og-usipon nu? Iyan podom usipon nu to diya namakadinog kanay, su namaan sikandan dow nokoy to ing-anad ku.”
Pag-ikagi ni Jesus to sikan, dajun sikandin sampaluha to sobuuk no magbantajay aw ikagihi, “Mayangub ka! Iyan sikan to igtabak nu to seini kinayabawan no magdudumaya to tinuuhan ta?”
Pig-ikagihan ni Jesus sikan magbantajay, “Ko madoot to diya pig-ikagi ku, matuuda dow nokoy to madoot duon. Di ko kona no madoot, nokoy no pigsampalu a nu man?”
Dajun ipadaya ni Anas si Jesus no ginapus gihapun diya ki Caifas no kinayabawan no magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru.
To Paglidung Manda ni Pedro ki Jesus
Na, si Pedro no migtindog no nanghinadang pad duon to pawa pig-usip to mgo otow duon, “Kona no sobuuk ka man no inanad to sikan otow?” Di miglidung si Pedro no mig-iling, “Eh, kona.”
Mey suguonon to sikan kinayabawan no magdudumaya no kadumahan to diya pigsagpingan ni Pedro to talinga. Kagi din ki Pedro, “Angod to pigkita ku sikuna ganina no duma ni Jesus diya to kakajuhan.”
Miglidung manda si Pedro, aw duon-dajun migtagauk to manuk.
Si Jesus duon to Atubangan ni Pilato

Saju pad to masem, pigdaya si Jesus likat to bayoy ni Caifas pailing diya to bayoy to gubernadur no taga-Roma. To mgo Hibru wada sed duon su unu ko maligsoman sikandan ojow pa to balaod to tinuuhan dan, aw iyan hinongdan no kona sikandan ogpakakoon to pagkoonan to Pista to Pagyaboy.
Kaling migyuwas si Gubernadur Pilato aw usipa sikandan, “Nokoy man to riklamu now kuntra to seini no otow?”
Migtabak sikandan, “Ko kona pa no maaslag
to sae din, kona noy ogdaehon dini ikow.”
Kagi ni Pilato, “Sikiyu to muhukum kandin pinasikad to iyu no balaod.” “Eh, kona ogkahimu,” kagi to sikan mgo Hibru. “Su wada katongod noy to pagpahimatoy to otow.”
Nailing to sikan agun no matuman to diya pig-ikagi ni Jesus dow ogkaamonu to paghimatoy kandin.
Dajun sed si Pilato duon to bayoy aw sugu no daehon si Jesus duon kandin aw usipa din, “Sikuna iyan to hari to mgo Hibru?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Nokoy man to igpasabut nu to sikan og-ilingon nu no hari a? Hari a sumaya to pagsabut nu ubin ko pagsabut to mgo Hibru no mig-ikagi ikow bahin kanay?”
Kagi ni Pilato, “Nokoy man to pagtuu nu, Hibru a? To angod nu no mgo Hibru iyan migdaya ikow dini kanay, yakip to yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan now. Na, nangoni a dow nokoy to sae nu.”

Migtabak si Jesus, “To paghari ku kona no kani to seini kalibutan. Su ko mailing pa to sikan, ogpanalipodan a podom to mgo ginsakupan ku agun kona a madakop to sikan mgo Hibru. Di to paghari ku wada yabot to seini kalibutan.”

Dajun usip si Pilato, “Hari ka naan?” Kagi ni Jesus, “Ko hari to igtawag nu kanay, na hala sigi. Iyan ing-andini ku to kalibutan su ogpang-anad a to matuud, aw to tibo mgo otow no ogkaliyag no mamaan to matuud ogpaminog kanay.”
Kagi ni Pilato, “Indoy dow nokoy sikan og-ilingon to matuud.” Dajun isab yuwas sikandin aw ikagihi sikan mgo Hibru no nahimun duon, “Wada nakitaan ku no sae din.
Na, su nabatasan now man no ogpasabukan now to songo prisu panahon to Pista to Pagyaboy, nokoy man, ogkaliyag kow ko iyan pasabukan ku sikan og-ilingon to hari to mgo Hibru?”
Dajun sikandan kinuliya, “Kona no sikandin! Si Barabas da!” Na, si Barabas, ribeldi.

footnotes.text: Ko mangusip si Pilato dow hari si Jesus no ogsupak to gubernu, iyan igtabak ni Jesus to “Kona.” Di ko mangusip si Pilato dow sikandin to diya ogpaharion to Diyus to mgo Hibru, na, ogtabak si Jesus to “Hoo.” Kaling igpaklaru ni Jesus to usip ni Pilato.
